# Savewave

> Savewave is a privacy-focused public-media saver with a lightweight installation website and on-device native extraction.

## Product

- Workflow: Paste -> Resolve -> Preview -> Save.
- The website is an app-download landing page; it contains no browser downloader and does not run or proxy yt-dlp.
- Desktop extraction uses bundled yt-dlp and FFmpeg locally through Tauri.
- Private, login-gated, cookie-only, paid and DRM-protected content is unsupported.
- No accounts, media upload, cloud extraction, cookies, or browser sessions.
- Download history is bounded and stored only inside the installed application on that device.
